title: The Daily Life of a Salted Fish Shadow Guard
associated: 咸鱼暗卫打工日常
synopsis:
Shi Jiu, a modern-day office worker, unexpectedly died from overwork and exhaustion. When he opened his eyes, he found himself transmigrated to ancient times. Before he could even rejoice at his second chance at life, he received terrible news:
He had become a shadow guard. His job was to crouch on roof beams every day, protecting his master. His working hours stretched from midnight to midnight, 365 days a year, with no rest.
Shi Jiu: …
Shi Jiu: Living is fine, but dying is also acceptable.
Reborn, Shi Jiu refused to work overtime. He spent his days slacking off, showing up late, leaving early, and generally doing as little as possible. The good news was that he was the least conspicuous of all the shadow guards. For three months, he got away with his slacking without anyone noticing.
The bad news? Because his presence was so minimal, his master—the paranoid Tyrant—assigned him to infiltrate Prince Ning’s Manor as an undercover agent.
Rumor had it that Prince Ning was a sickly weakling, gasping for breath with every step and coughing three times with every word. He was naturally lazy, utterly lacking in learning or skill, and his days were numbered.
On his first day as an undercover agent, Shi Jiu crouched on the roof beam, watching the endless stream of guests arriving at Prince Ning’s Manor. Amidst laughter and clinking cups, they debated state affairs with fervent passion.
After pondering for a long time, Shi Jiu reported to his master: Today, His Highness Prince Ning spent the entire day playing pai gow with his guests.
A month into his mission, Shi Jiu hid beneath Prince Ning’s carriage, following him to the outskirts of the city to inspect his privately raised troops. He reported to his master: Today, His Highness Prince Ning spent the entire day playing pai gow.
Three months into his assignment, Prince Ning suddenly fell gravely ill. Clutching Shi Jiu’s hand, he begged him not to leave. Shi Jiu sat by the bedside, reporting to his master: Prince Ning, driven by his relentless pai gow addiction, has finally exhausted himself into illness. Today, he examined his conscience thrice and vowed never to play pai gow again tomorrow.
A year into his mission, Shi Jiu watched Prince Ning’s fully assembled army. Grasping the hand Prince Ning extended toward him, he reported to his master: Today, His Highness Prince Ning invited me to play pai gow with him.
Later, Prince Ning finally overthrew the Tyrant and ascended the Dragon Throne as the new Emperor. Shi Jiu lay sprawled on the Dragon Throne, massaging his aching lower back—
Who the hell said Prince Ning was on his last legs?!
………………….
Just a shadow guard, how did I end up as Empress?!
If my boss makes me work 24/7, I’ll just find a new boss.

title: I Woke Up in the Body of a Newly Appointed Marshal

The System tells Qin Yunzhi: if he wants to be resurrected, he must save this collapsing world by changing Qi Zhao and ensuring he never attacks the protagonist. Qin Yunzhi: “…So, I’ve been handed the Savior’s script?”

In this fake world, Qin Yunzhi is the only thing that matters.

System: 【Host, long time no see.】
Qin Yunzhi flinches at the sudden voice.
The System takes human form and tearfully clings to his leg: 【It’s over! It’s all over! Qi Zhao has completely blackened. His influence has surpassed even the protagonist’s!】
Looking at the snot-faced System with disgust, Qin Yunzhi pulls his leg away. “So… I’m going back?”
The System stops crying instantly: 【Great! That’s exactly what I wanted to hear!】
Qin Yunzhi’s vision goes black. When he opens his eyes, he sees a matured Qi Zhao standing before him—while he himself is sitting on Qi Zhao’s lap, completely naked. I’m fine with coming back, but why are my clothes gone?!

title: The Angst Novel’s Protagonist Won’t Let Me Cry
associated: 虐文主角不许我哭
synopsis:

In his world, everything revolved around him—he woke up in luxury, his hair changed color with his mood, and even his tears turned into priceless gemstones. Effortless, beautiful, adored… it was a life straight out of a dream.
Until the system appeared and shattered it all.
He wasn’t the protagonist.
He was just a spoiled cannon fodder character mistakenly placed in the wrong story—and now, the world was being “corrected.” He would be sent back to where he truly belonged.
A brutal angst novel.
There, the real protagonist, Yu Li, had clawed his way up from endless suffering—cold, ruthless, and utterly merciless—destined to stand at the peak… and eventually destroy the entire world.
The moment Ning Yao arrives, a divine sword is already at his throat.
He’s so terrified he starts crying on the spot—gemstones scattering across the ground.
Yu Li pauses.
Then lowers his sword, grabs Ning Yao by the collar, and says coldly—
“From now on, you will cry half a chest of gemstones every day. Or I’ll kill you.”
—
At first, Ning Yao cries pitifully, clinging and whining, his eyes red. “It hurts…”
Yu Li doesn’t even look at him.
Later…
A grain of sand gets into Ning Yao’s eye—and someone is already pulling him into a protective embrace.
“Don’t cry,” Yu Li says, his voice still cold, his hold unexpectedly gentle. “Are you trying to take my life?”
—
In his past life, Yu Li walked through darkness alone, feared like a demon.
Reborn, the world was nothing more than a stage for revenge—until he met Ning Yao.
From that moment on, all his cruelty and indifference turned into something else—something that would never allow Ning Yao to shed another tear.
His sun.
The one who brought him warmth and light…
and the one he would pull into his arms, claim completely, and never let go.

title: Beta Is Your Lie

synopsis:

After serving as a mere “spare tire” backup, he was eventually driven to his death by that very Omega, and his family’s assets were liquidated to serve as a dowry for the protagonist couple.
Pei Qian: “…”
All he wanted was to attend military school, inherit the family business, and stay as far away from the leads as possible. He made a vow to dodge their “romantic plays” at all costs. However, Pei Qian never expected that he wouldn’t be able to turn a blind eye to Zhou Xi—the protagonist Omega’s “foil” and a fellow “Beta” fake young master.

The second time: Zhou Xi was locked in a training room because the Omega’s friends wanted to “seek justice” for their pal.
The third time: Zhou Xi was being forced to hand over his spoils of war to the Omega simply because the Omega saw them first—even though Zhou Xi was the one who actually won them.
Pei Qian: “For heaven’s sake…”
There’s a limit to how much you can bully someone. If they want to label Zhou Xi a “vicious villain,” fine—Pei Qian decided right then and there to be his protector.
For Zhou Xi’s sake, Pei Qian became the protagonist Omega’s number-one hater. While the whole school adored the Omega, he stood alone by Zhou Xi’s side. He raised his own faction to openly challenge the protagonist Alpha, effectively splitting the First Military Academy into two warring camps. Eventually, Pei Qian rose to become the strongest Legion Commander, surpassing even the original leads. Zhou Xi never had to fear being bullied again.
Pei Qian looked after him so well that he ended up turning the clean, aloof “Beta” into his own wife.
Pei Qian: “I guess this works. Since things ended up like this, I might as well keep him for myself…”
The morning after they finally confessed their feelings, Pei Qian sat up clutching his neck, questioning his entire reality. He glared at Zhou Xi, who was calmly getting dressed.
“I thought you were a Beta!”
What kind of Beta pins an Alpha down like that?!
Zhou Xi: “Who told you I was a Beta? Darling, I’m an Enigma.”
One-liner: I’ve had enough of this world where every Alpha ends up as a bottom!

title: Villain! You’re Out of Character!

synopsis:
Chi Xu wakes up inside the comic Walking with Darkness and, before his borrowed memories return, brings home a boy beautiful enough to stop him in his tracks. Then he realizes the stranger is Chumu You—the story’s most unhinged yandere villain—and that the minor character whose body Chi Xu now inhabits is supposed to die by Chumu You’s hand that very night.
Desperate to survive, Chi Xu tries everything to send him away. Nothing works. The more Chi Xu struggles to keep his distance, the more the apparently innocent boy clings to him, calling him Big Brother and promising to obey, protect, and maim anyone who dares touch him.
As the comic’s plot veers off course, Chi Xu begins to think that being guarded by a beautiful little madman might be better than being killed by one. At least, until he fakes his death.
When they meet again, the harmless puppy has grown into a full-fledged wolf. Chumu You pins Chi Xu against the wall, possessiveness burning beneath every word: “Big Brother, remember? You’re mine. Anyone who touches you dies.”
